audio.strategy: One piano voice, honestly synthesized: a deterministic additive stack of six sine partials per note with per-partial exponential decay, inharmonic stretch, register-scaled decay, a 2 ms hammer attack, and a damper-down release envelope. Each (note, velocity) pair is rendered to a buffer by src/audio/voice.ts and played through a per-voice gain into a master gain (src/audio/web-audio-backend.ts). Tests render the identical pure function via src/audio/fake-backend.ts. No recorded samples are used in Phase 1; nothing is described as a recording.

generatedSources.name: synth-piano-basic
generatedSources.notes: Deterministic function of (MIDI note, velocity); 6 partials, gains 1.0/0.52/0.30/0.18/0.10/0.05, decay 1.4-8.6 s^-1 scaled by register, release envelope 0.35 s. Generated in code at runtime; no audio files shipped.

notes: Phase 1 honesty contract: every panel control is decorative; only keybed notes and sustain (UI spacebar mapping and MIDI CC64) drive the engine.
When Web Audio is unavailable the app shows the labeled 'Silent fallback' status and produces no sound rather than pretending to play.
Voice stealing is deterministic (oldest released voice first, then oldest held), polyphony is 16 voices, and blur/disconnect/unmount stop every owned voice.
